text:
[Council File 11-1019]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (McOSKER - BLUMENFIELD) relative to reactivating and restoring Council File No. 11-1019 to its most recent legislative status as of the date of the File’s expiration.
Recommendation for Council action:
REACTIVATE and RESTORE the matter relative to the development of a regional governance system for Neighborhood Councils, including opportunities for regional administration and the sharing of administrative resources and services, as recorded under Council file No. 11-1019, which expired pursuant to Council Policy (Council file No. 05-0553), to its most recent legislative status as of the date of the File’s expiration.
